plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control skin: limma-trend DE + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a single gene-level TPM matrix from Salmon (12,000 genes x 12 sample columns, /data/inputs/abundance/tpm.csv) plus a 12-row metadata table with a condition column (6 lesional, 6 control skin, unpaired, single batch). No raw counts and no Salmon quantification directories were delivered, which is the single fact that determines the method: DESeq2, edgeR and voom all model integer counts with a negative-binomial (or count-derived precision-weight) variance and are invalid on within-sample-scaled abundances. The plan therefore runs limma with trend=TRUE and robust=TRUE on log2(TPM+1) — the sourced procedure for TPM/FPKM input — and does not attempt to reconstruct counts from TPM. T1S1 does sample-structure QC on the log matrix (PCA/MDS on the 500 most variable genes, sample-distance heatmap, detected-gene counts per sample) so any sample that does not sit with its condition group is named before the model rather than after. T1S2 filters to genes at >=1 TPM in at least 6 samples (the smallest group size), fits ~condition with control as the explicit reference so a positive logFC means higher in lesional, and reports BH-adjusted results at FDR 0.05, with a TREAT test against |log2FC| >= 1 as the effect-size-thresholded companion rather than a post-hoc fold-change filter. T2S1 takes the full ranked list of tested genes — never a thresholded list — into fgsea against the human MSigDB hallmark collection, with GO BP as the second collection (Reactome C2 is not staged here; hallmark and GO BP are). The ranking statistic is a disputed choice: this plan uses the limma moderated t statistic, the direct analogue of the DESeq2 Wald statistic (signed and scaled by the standard error), and states that choice in the report. T1S3 assembles the report with the reproducibility record. Psoriasis lesional skin is a strong-effect, well-characterised contrast (expect IL-17/IL-23 axis, keratinocyte defensins S100A7/S100A8/S100A9, DEFB4A, KRT6/16/17, CXCL cytokines), so a result with no such signal is a reason to suspect the TPM table or the sample labels rather than a negative finding — the report must say which way it fell. Two standing caveats belong in the write-up: TPM values are not comparable across library protocols, and 12,000 genes is a pre-subset matrix, so the tested universe is not the full transcriptome and enrichment p-values are conditioned on that subset.
